Kontrol edin:  Measuring Value Blocks (MVB) for Supply Voltage
technicalNotes: One faulty sensor can cause this DTC and drop the Sensör Okuma Değerleri Voltage Supply MVB reading.  Unplugging the front -or- rear wiring harness to eliminate 4 sensors at a time is advised during the diagnosis.  Make sure to cycle the ignition off and back on before evaluating the MVBs.  After the front -or- rear of the vehicle are determined to be problematic it is recommended to unplug the senors one at a time to see which one crashes the  Sensör Okuma Değerleri Voltage Supply MVB reading.
